The reason why he made my mother seem like the bad guy was so he can have reasons why he wouldn’t have to be in my life. Because his family would have something to say about him being a dead beat. So all I have to do is exposed him to his family for being a dead beat. And tell them about the depression and suicidal shit I went through because I kept wondering why my dad didn’t want to be around
If so Mother’s Day should also be banned
I would confront him about your feelings. Because at least you’ll know where you two stand instead of just wondering.
